title: Route Inspector: Layered Latency Waterfall & Token Funnel UI
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design a compact, actionable Route Inspector panel that surfaces per-route and per-model performance signals in two complementary visual layers: a layered latency waterfall that breaks down server-side token latency by stage (preprocessing, queueing, kernel execution, KV fetch, postprocessing) and a token funnel that visualizes token counts, cache hit ratio, and cost-per-token across request cohorts. The goal is to give SREs and product engineers a single view for triage, RCA, and capacity tuning without needing to jump between charts.
acceptance_criteria: Final Figma screens for desktop and narrow tablet showing the Route Inspector collapsed and expanded states
Latency waterfall spec that defines layers, color tokens, stack order, sample aggregation method, and hover microtrace details
Token funnel spec including cohort bucketing rules, axes, and drilldown behavior into per-request sample list
Interactive prototype (Figma/Proto) demonstrating hover, time-range scrub, and model-variant fallback highlighting
Design handoff doc with component tokens, CSS vars, and accessibility notes (contrast, keyboard nav)
PM and ENG signoff comments captured in ticket and linked PR for implementation plan
chart_specs_summary: Layered latency waterfall: stacked area-style horizontal bars per time window. Layers: client-rcv, preprocessing, queue, kernel-exec, kv-io, postproc, network-send. X axis = p50/p75/p95/p99 ranges selectable; Y axis = requests per window. Token Funnel: stacked vertical bars for cohort buckets (short, medium, long), segments = prompt tokens, response tokens, cached tokens. Cost-per-token heat column aligned to funnel. Sparklines for throughput (rps) and avg token latency. Exportable CSV with raw layer timings and token counts.
interaction_notes: Hover waterfall layer to show aggregated microtraces and sample request IDs; click sample opens request inspector in right panel
Time-range scrub updates both waterfall and funnel simultaneously; scrub shows instantaneous breakdown and streaming preview
Click model variant chip to filter both charts; long-press on chip triggers quick-compare mode (two variant split view)
Keyboard: focus moves between charts with arrow keys; Enter toggles drilldown on selected bucket
decisions: Use stacked horizontal layout for waterfall to maximize time-series density in narrow panels
Aggregate outlier requests into an 'overflow' lane rather than distorting scale at p99
Show cached token counts as a distinct color in funnel to surface cache impact on cost
Avoid raw microtrace glyphs in list view — use sampled thumbnails to keep perf smooth
engineering_feedback: ENG review 2026-03-04: Prefer proto data shape as {window_ts, counts, layer_ms} to avoid wide column explosion; will provide mock API
ENG note: kernel-exec times may require moving-average smoothing to prevent spiky waterfall; suggest backend support for percentile-over-time pre-aggregation
ENG question: can funnel cohorts be limited to top 10K requests? backend to advise on cost for arbitrary range queries
